name: CoreAppTopBar
intent: The product top bar: project/org switcher, breadcrumb/title, feedback and actions, with density matching CoreAppSidebar.
when: The header row of the Core app shell

chooseOver.because: NavigationMenu for link-based site nav; CoreAppTopBar is the product header

commonMistakes.mistake: Wrapping CoreAppTopBar in another bordered or card-colored header
commonMistakes.symptom: A doubled horizontal divider or a darker strip appears under the shell header
commonMistakes.fix: Place CoreAppTopBar directly in the shell. It owns its height, background, padding, and bottom border.
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Do not add border-b, background, height, or horizontal padding to a wrapper around CoreAppTopBar.

ownership.expectedWrapper: Direct shell child with no border, background, fixed height, or horizontal padding.
